app.name: Beej Dost
app.slogan: Preserve heritage seeds, connect verified growers, cultivate abundance.

home.heroTitle: Verified Heritage & Agricultural Seeds Across Pakistan
home.heroSubtitle: Direct farmer-to-farmer seed exchange and marketplace. Find climate-resilient local varieties, heirloom grains, cotton, pulses, and vegetables with certified origin.

features.verifiedDesc: Direct peer ratings and district-level verification of seed provenance.
features.climateDesc: Discover varieties optimized for Sindh salinity, Punjab canal zones, KP valleys, and Balochistan drylands.
features.bilingualDesc: Available in English, Urdu, and Shahmukhi Punjabi, fully functional even on intermittent connectivity.
